metadata.description: Ask Gina is a research assistant for crypto, prediction markets, perpetuals, and equities. Use it to fetch real-time prices and historical data for tokens, Hyperliquid markets, and Polymarket prediction markets, and to analyze your Gina wallet, positions, and accounts.

plugins.name: ask-gina
plugins.description: Read-only Ask Gina research for wallets, spot tokens, Hyperliquid, and Polymarket. Cannot place trades or transfer assets.
